verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents subscribe-only participant tokens, and agents that consume room media such as video input. Together these show an agent can join a live room as a pure subscriber while publishers keep publishing as usual. The evidence never shows choosing one specific track to subscribe to, and single-track egress export is a separate feature, not agent subscription. missing for 10: documented selective per-track subscription for agents, explicit statement that publishers need no changes, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent subscribes to a single track of a live broadcast without the publisher changing anything about how it publishes
